neighbours.label: the word neighbour/neighbor in any language (neighbor, neighbourhood, neighborly, сосед, 邻/鄰), as against other people or places near you
fire: When the storm hit, our neighbor helped us clear the fallen branches.
The old man was a quiet neighbour who grew roses by the fence.
Kids in the neighborhood play football in the street after school.
The village is known for its neighborly spirit and open doors.

我们的邻居送来了一盒月饼。
